mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated rates increase the cost of capital and reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 12-month rolling mean, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative equity returns as corporate earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during periods when FEDFUNDS is rising at a rate of at least 0.5% per month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary environment, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as both inflation and economic weakness pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (as indicated by slowing housing starts), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to the anticipation of economic slowdown and potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions (defined by HOUST growth rate below 1.0% annually), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 0.5% signals weak economic expansion, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth falters.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
